rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a sweet baked cake.

example.english: I bought a cake to celebrate my birthday.
example.traditional: 我買咗個蛋糕慶祝生日。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 daan6 gou1 hing3 zuk1 saang1 jat6

rows.note: A colloquial loanword used as a shorter alternative to 蛋糕, especially when the context already makes the meaning clear.

example.english: Someone at the office treated us to cake today.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 gung1 si1 jau5 jan4 ceng2 sik6 kik1
